title: Northwestern vs PennState: control, tuition, size
summary: Northwestern University (Northwestern) versus Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (PennState). Also searched as PennState vs Northwestern. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Northwestern University vs Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (Northwestern vs PennState) differ primarily in ownership, size, cost, and location. Northwestern is a private nonprofit institution located in Evanston, while Penn State Altoona is a public university situated in Altoona. The undergraduate enrollment at Northwestern is significantly larger, with 9,201 students compared to Penn State Altoona's 2,367. Tuition costs also vary widely, as Northwestern charges $68,322 for in-state tuition, whereas Penn State Altoona's in-state tuition is $15,972. These distinctions highlight differences in institutional structure and student demographics between Northwestern and Penn State.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing cost, Northwestern University vs Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (Northwestern vs PennState) show notable differences in tuition and student debt. Northwestern, a private institution, charges $68,322 for both in-state and out-of-state tuition, reflecting its uniform tuition policy. In contrast, Penn State Altoona, as a public university, has a lower in-state tuition of $15,972 and an out-of-state tuition of $26,958. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Northwestern is $15,000, which is lower than Penn State Altoona's median debt of $25,000. These figures illustrate the higher upfront cost of attending Northwestern but a comparatively lower median debt burden for its graduates compared to Penn State Altoona.

Overall, Northwestern vs PennState differ significantly in financial aspects, with Northwestern's tuition being substantially higher but median debt for students being lower, while Penn State Altoona offers more affordable tuition but results in higher median debt for its graduates.

paragraphs: Northwestern University vs Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (Northwestern vs PennState) differ in their learning environments and campus settings. sections.heading: Pick PennState if
paragraphs: Pick Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona if you prefer a public institution with a high admission rate of approximately 98.06%, indicating a more accessible entry process.
